title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-jul-2026-asha-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - prep notes
Date: 2026-07-09 10:00am PT (30-45m)
Location: Zoom / #roadmap-sync
Attendees (expected): Priya (PM), Miguel (Eng lead - serving runtime), Daniel (Applied ML), Taylor (SRE - optional), me (Asha)
Objectives:
- Align on proposed Q3 roadblocks and dependencies for hosted API + model onboarding cadence
- Decide on prioritization for: (1) KV/prefix cache improvements, (2) quantization profile rollout, (3) model-variant fallback policy for high load
- Confirm owners and rough timelines for experiments we want to run before next exec review

Agenda (proposed):
- 0-5m: Quick round (status updates)
- 5-15m: Product priorities & customer asks (Priya)
  - Top requests: deterministic latency for short-chat flows, lower cost embeddings for similarity search, private deployment checklist for legal review
- 15-30m: Eng constraints & trade-offs (Miguel)
  - Autoscaling/burst capacity ETA, risky infra changes (kernel updates), testing approach for new batching logic
- 30-40m: Applied ML ask & experiments (Daniel)
  - Small-model quantization A/B plan, eval datasets needed, quality vs perf thresholds
- 40-45m: Decision & action items recap

Key context / talking points to surface:
- Customers pushing for predictable p95 latency < 200ms for prompt length <= 128 tokens on Hosted API. We currently meet p50 but p95 spikes on mixed workloads. Need clarity on whether to prioritize caching or smaller-model fallbacks.
- Quantization profiles: Applied ML recommends per-model 4-bit profile for many open models. Eng concerns: accuracy regressions and additional CI runtime cost. Proposed: small canary fleet in Dedicated for 2 weeks.
- Model-variant fallback: Product wants automatic fallback to cheaper variant when capacity constrained. Eng says this requires metadata catalog and compatibility matrix. How much work is it? (estimate request)

Open questions to ask the group:
- Miguel: Rough estimate for implementing prefix caching improvements (ticketed as ENG-10120). Is 4-6 weeks realistic with current sprint load?
- Daniel: For quantization canary, what evaluation thresholds should trigger rollback? Need concrete metrics (delta perplexity, downstream eval accuracy, human eval sample size).
- Priya: Which customers should we include in early rollout for model-variant fallback? Any enterprise accounts with strict SLAs to exclude?

Proposed decisions for the sync (so we can close during meeting):
1) Approve a 2-week Dedicated canary for 4-bit quantized models (owner: Daniel)
2) Prioritize prefix/KV cache improvements for Q3 sprint 2 (owner: Miguel) with minimal viable rollout on Hosted API behind feature flag
3) Kick off a small cross-team task to define model compatibility matrix + metadata (owner: Asha / Product ops)

Risks / trade-offs:
- Canary risk: transient quality regressions hitting customers. Mitigation: route canary to internal beta orgs + Redwood staff accounts and enable feature-flag rollback.
- Eng workload: shifting cycles to cache changes may delay other infra improvements. Need to re-evaluate sprint commitments by Friday.

Action items (pre-meeting prep / owners) - to bring into sync:
- Miguel: bring quick ETA (low/med/high) for ENG-10120 (prefix cache) by meeting (Due: 2026-07-09)
- Daniel: prepare proposed evaluation thresholds and sample size for quantization canary (Due: 2026-07-08)
- Priya: list top 3 customer accounts impacted by latency and any SLAs to consider (Due: 2026-07-08)
- Asha (me): draft compatibility matrix template and a short runbook for fallback behavior (Due: 2026-07-10)

Parking lot / follow-ups post-sync:
- If we greenlight canary: coordinate infra resources with Dedicated team + billing contact to isolate cost center. (Follow-up: finance + dedicated infra ops)
- Create a short eval dashboard (perf + quality) for the canary; ask Observability team for a template. (Owner: Observability eng - sync separately)

Notes to self (things to say):
- Emphasize small incremental experiments rather than big-bang rollouts.
- Push for measurable guardrails (metrics + thresholds) before enabling fallbacks.
- Ask for one concrete commit (owner + date) at the end of the meeting for each decision.

Quick references / links I should have handy during meeting:
- Confluence: roadmap overview page (linked_artifacts above)
- Jira: ENG-10120 (prefix cache), ENG-10333 (autoscale fixes), ML-227 (quantization canary)
- PR: runtime batching optimization (github link above)

Draft follow-up email template (post-sync):
Subject: Recap + action items - Cross-functional roadmap sync (Jul 9)
Hi all - thanks for joining. Summary of decisions, owners and due dates: [list]. If any of the owners above need to reassign, please reply by EOD Friday.

Mental checklist for meeting day:
- Have ETA bullets ready (Miguel)
- Daniel: one slide with evaluation thresholds and a short example of potential regression impacts
- Priya: prioritized customer list + one-line impact statements
- Bring up capacity routing policy (small ask) if time allows

End of notes.
